Overview

The product integrates the photovoltaic inverter or converter energy-storage PCS, transformer and high-voltage switch for photovoltaic and energy-storage substations that can be installed quickly on site.

Suitable for projects with poor geological conditions and short construction periods, and remote PV and storage projects with poor construction conditions.

ItemUnitParameter
Rated voltagekVLow voltage 0.315–1.14; high voltage 7.2–40.5

Transformer type—Dry-type or oil-immersed transformer
High-voltage switchgear—Air-insulated cabinet or gas-insulated switchgear (C-GIS), handcart or fixed type; load switch, fuse or circuit breaker; incoming, outgoing, voltage protection, contact lifting and metering cabinets
Low-voltage switchgear—Fixed or drawer type; incoming, outgoing, capacitor compensation and metering cabinets
Breaking current—Low voltage: 50–100 kA; high voltage: 20–40 kA

The table reflects the rating range to 9,000 kVA. Designs up to 15,000 kVA are available, matched to the inverter or PCS.
